info.title: game-intel
info.summary: Public read API and remote MCP for published game-intel JSON.
info.description: Anonymous reads are allowed. An optional API key (X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer) raises the /v1 and /mcp limit. Anonymous: 120 requests per 60 seconds per IP. Key: 1200 per 60 seconds per key. Limits are enforced only when the Worker rate-limit bindings exist, and counters are per Cloudflare location. Over limit: HTTP 429 and Retry-After. A presented key that is not in the GAME_INTEL_API_KEYS secret is HTTP 401. The secret is not in the repository. POST /v1/claims ignores that key and keeps its own KV limiter (10 per IP per Asia/Shanghai hour, 100 per day). CLAIMS_API_KEY is not required. Responses send X-API-Version: 1. Published JSON bodies are not wrapped. Health and gate errors include api_version. Gate errors are {ok:false, error, message, api_version, status}. Claims submission errors keep their existing body. MCP protocol errors stay JSON-RPC. Deep games / 深耕: hw, nikke, bd2, reverse-1999, arknights-endfield, limbus-company, zenless-zone-zero, wuthering-waves. Banners and codes keep the source URL and an explicit status. Do not invent rates, prices, or skill numbers. Source priority: official > review sites > forums. If the JSON does not support a claim, say 未见可靠出处. MIT covers this site's code. Facts, names, and portraits stay attributed to the https sources stored on each row. Developer page: /developers/.

post.summary: Submit a sourced claim. No API key. Claims rate limit is unchanged.
post.description: No API key. Authorization and X-API-Key are ignored and do not change the quota. Requires statement (1–2000 chars), 1–8 https sources, and game_id. Body max 16384 bytes. Rate limit is the existing CLAIMS KV limiter: 10 posts per IP per Asia/Shanghai hour and 100 per calendar day. This limiter is not the public /v1 read limiter. Stored rows are untrusted until a human reviews them. There is no pending queue.

201.description: Stored. Untrusted until a human reviews it.

400.description: Missing or invalid statement, game_id, or source.

429.description: Claims limiter: 10 per IP per hour, or 100 per day. Body keeps scope and limit. Not the public read limiter.

503.description: Claims KV binding is not configured.

post.summary: Read-only MCP streamable HTTP. Tools include list_banners, list_codes, and personal_digest.
post.description: Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC. Protocol errors stay JSON-RPC. HTTP 401 and 429 from the public gate use the unified Error body, not a JSON-RPC envelope. Tools are read-only and include list_banners, list_codes, and personal_digest for the eight deep games.

405.description: GET is not an SSE stream. Use POST.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Optional. Higher /v1 and /mcp limit. Not used by POST /v1/claims.

bearer.description: Optional. Same keys as X-API-Key. Not used by POST /v1/claims.

ETag.description: Strong validator for GET JSON and other 200 responses.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait. Equals the rate-limit period.

InvalidKey.description: A key was sent and it is not in GAME_INTEL_API_KEYS.

RateLimited.description: Public limiter. Retry-After is 60. Not used for POST /v1/claims.

NotFound.description: No published document at this path.

ClaimsError.description: Existing claims submission error. Unchanged. 429 includes scope and limit.

rate_limit.description: degraded means a rate-limit binding is missing and requests are allowed.

ClaimInput.title: game-intel sourced claim
ClaimInput.description: Public POST /v1/claims body. No API key. statement, sources, and game_id are required. sources must be https URLs with a real host (not javascript:, data:, http:, empty, IP literals, localhost, or placeholder hosts such as example.com). Caps: statement 2000 chars, 1–8 sources, each URL ≤ 500, body ≤ 16384 bytes. Rate limit: 10 per IP per Asia/Shanghai hour and 100 per calendar day globally.

game.description: Alias of game_id. The API accepts either.

ClaimsIndex.title: game-intel claims mirror
ClaimsIndex.description: Read-only mirror of public claim submissions. There is no pending/approved queue. Rows are untrusted until a human reviews them. list_claims returns this same list.

Game.title: game-intel game entity
Game.description: Light catalog rows (stub true, watchlist false) store identity only: name, platforms, tags, sources, steam_appid. Character guide cards are published only for watchlist games. Do not invent scores, prices, or player counts. If a fact has no https source, say 未见可靠出处. When sources disagree: official > review sites > forums.

sources.description: https only (Steam store and/or official site). Never invent. When citing, official > review sites > forums.

steam_appid.description: Steam AppID when known; omit or null if unknown

stub.description: true = light catalog identity only (no character card, no scores). false = watchlist game that may have guides.

watchlist.description: true = deep-dive watch list (character cards may exist). false = directory stub.

guides_path.description: Human guides path when coverage exists, e.g. /guides/hw/

GamesIndex.title: game-intel games catalog index
GamesIndex.description: Directory index. Stub rows are identity-only. Character cards are not listed here; they live under /v1/guides for watchlist games.

note.description: Catalog rule: stub true = name/platforms/tags/sources/steam_appid only. Unverified facts: 未见可靠出处.

CatalogAliases.title: game-intel catalog aliases
CatalogAliases.description: Nickname → catalog id. Resolve the alias, then GET /v1/games/{id}.json. Character nicknames are /v1/guides/{game}/aliases.json, not this file.

as_of.description: Asia/Shanghai date or month the card was verified, e.g. 2026-09

allOf.description: Non-stub cards (stub absent or false) must cite sources and as_of.

skill_prio.description: Cited 加点 / 练度 lines. Empty when the source does not state an order or level.

teams.description: Short cited 配队 notes. HW dopamine_auto is A/B/C from the auto roster. HW mode cells story, rift_45, dopamine, spec_ops, union, training are √ or × from the GameKee 适用场合表. comp is an array of verbatim sentences. A BD2 costume name key is that costume's 测评 line. Empty object when no sentence was published.

sources.description: Verified source URLs (GameKee / Prydwen / Bahamut). Required when stub is not true.

stub.description: true = placeholder; do not invent skills

as_of.description: Required on non-stub cards. Asia/Shanghai date or month.

portrait.description: Public https portrait for hw, nikke, and bd2. null when no cited image loaded. GameKee entry icons are cdnimg-v2.gamekee.com; a Nikke card with no icon may use a cdn.prydwen.gg image that appears on a Prydwen page already in sources.

portrait_source.description: URL the portrait was read from. GameKee cards cite /v1/entry/list. Prydwen fallbacks cite that character page. null when portrait is null.

portrait_via.description: Which field supplied the URL, e.g. gamekee-entry-icon:hw:163036 or prydwen-character:biscuit. null when portrait is null.

summary.description: Human+AI conclusion line. Required on non-stub HW/NIKKE/BD2 cards at export. summary.stub true = thin evidence (no invented tier/pull). Omit on skill stubs.

tier.description: Verified strength line, e.g. GameKee T度. Do not invent.

position.description: Catalog class/element/rarity when no verified tier exists.

pull.description: Pull advice copied from a cited source. No invented numbers.

skip.description: What not to chase, only when a source says so.

caveat.description: Honest limit of the conclusion (missing tier list, no pull text).

stub.description: true = conclusion incomplete; do not treat tier/pull as verified.

sources.description: Verified source URLs for the conclusion bar

sinner.description: Limbus Company: the sinner this Identity card belongs to. Game and follow pages group by sinner.id. Other games omit it.

sin_affinities.description: Limbus Company sin resource counts copied from the identity page. Do not invent a count.

Personal.title: game-intel personal digest
Personal.description: Stateless filter of published feed, digest, banners, and codes. The server does not store the games or chars list.

status.description: Known values include current, upcoming, ended.

redeem_url.description: Publisher page, when one was published. This API does not redeem.

status.description: Known values: active, reported_working, listed_permanent, expired, expiry_not_stated, window_stated_without_year. Do not treat expired or expiry_not_stated as live.
